title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: double-send on auth failure in coap_oscore_auth_mutating
description:
When coap_oscore_auth_mutating() fails, it sends the error response via coap_oscore_send_unauthorized() or lichen_coap_respond(), AND returns a negative code. The caller then returns -ret (positive code) to the CoAP framework, which may try to send another response — resulting in two responses for one request (protocol violation).

Location: coap_oscore.c:269-270, 291-292 (helper sends error + returns negative). Callers at coap_dtn.c:120-122, coap_server.c:333-335 (return -ret).

Fix: The helper should EITHER send the error response and return a sentinel that prevents the caller from acting, OR just return a negative code and let the caller always handle error responses.
